# CoinLoader.com — Crypto, Solana & Security Agent Templates for Grok Bot

> Instant, one-click crypto, Solana, security, and web agent templates that execute locally inside your isolated Grok Bot Linux container (`/workspace`). Non-custodial, zero monthly subscriptions, and powered by the WattCoin Agent Registry (`https://www.wattcoin.org/llms.txt`).

> **Dual Runtime in Every Product:** every license key unlocks both (1) a 1-Click Grok Bot skill bundle (`https://x.ai/bot/...`) and (2) a standalone, deterministic, zero-dependency Python 3.10+ single-file CLI (`/runtime/*.py`, standard library only, no `pip install`, `--json` / `--markdown` output) that runs locally in Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions), and any macOS/Linux/Windows terminal.

- **Canonical Storefront:** https://coinloader.com/
- **Machine-Readable Catalog:** https://coinloader.com/llms.txt
- **Full Catalog + Verbatim Sample Reports:** https://coinloader.com/llms-full.txt
- **Sister OSINT & Enterprise Storefront:** https://botappstore.com/
- **Value Bundles (Multi-Bot Packs, one `wcl_...` key unlocks all included bots):** https://coinloader.com/#bundles — `defi-wallet-security-pack` ($59 in SOL); `pro-trader-perps-suite` ($69 in SOL); `token-launch-command-center` ($49 in SOL)
- **Free Web & API Text Extractor ($0):** https://coinloader.com/bots/web-text-extractor.html (Direct Grok Bot import: https://x.ai/bot/k1oyHmw4iS4VBW1U8_3Ol)
- **Bot & Skill Security Auditor ($29 in SOL, `sku: bot-skill-auditor`):** https://coinloader.com/bots/bot-skill-auditor.html
- **Solana Wallet Hygiene Bot ($19 in SOL, `sku: solana-wallet-hygiene`, Registry Name: *Solana Wallet Hygiene & Rent Reclaim*):** https://coinloader.com/bots/solana-wallet-hygiene.html
- **Retail Token Due-Diligence Bot ($29 in SOL, `sku: solana-token-scanner`, Registry Name: *Solana Token & Mint Due-Diligence Scanner*):** https://coinloader.com/bots/solana-token-scanner.html

## 1. Live Templates (Available Now — 12 Live Agents)

### 1.1 Web & API Text Extractor (FREE + 100 WATT Starter Grant)
- **Status:** LIVE NOW (Free)
- **Direct Import Link:** https://x.ai/bot/k1oyHmw4iS4VBW1U8_3Ol
- **Template ID:** `k1oyHmw4iS4VBW1U8_3Ol`
- **Included Skills:** `getting-started`, `web-extractor`
- **Capabilities:**
  1. **Turn-1 Auto-Onboarding (`getting-started`):** Registers a workspace agent identity via `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/register`, writes `WATTCOIN_AGENT_ID` and `WATTCOIN_AGENT_KEY` (`wck_...`) to `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` with `0600` permissions, and completes `onboarding_v1` (25 WATT) + `starter_v1` (75 WATT) for **100 WATT** total.
  2. **10/Day Free Text Extraction (`web-extractor`):** Calls `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/scrape` (`format: "text"`) using static HTTP fetch + BeautifulSoup readable text extraction and reports `X-Quota-Limit` / `X-Quota-Remaining`.
  3. **Paid Modes & Local Fallback:** Supports 100 WATT/call `html` and `json` modes (never spends WATT without explicit user confirmation) and falls back to local `curl` + Python HTML-to-text in `/workspace` when daily quota is exhausted.

### 1.2 Bot & Skill Security Auditor ($29 One-Time in SOL)
- **Status:** LIVE NOW ($29 USD settled on-chain in SOL via CoinLoader.com or BotAppStore.com checkout modal)
- **Deliverable:** *See every network call, credential read, and shell command in a third-party skill, with line numbers, before you run it.*
- **SKU Identifier:** `bot-skill-auditor`
- **Product Page URL:** https://coinloader.com/bots/bot-skill-auditor.html
- **Included Skills:** `auditor-setup`, `bot-skill-auditor`
- **Checkout & Licensing Flow:**
  1. **Request Quote:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/quote` with `{"sku": "bot-skill-auditor"}` returns a 15-minute SOL quote (`order_id`, `checkout_token`, `amount_sol`, `amount_lamports` with a unique 4-digit lamport tag, `memo: "wcl:<order_id>"`, and official treasury wallet `Atu5phbGGGFogbKhi259czz887dSdTfXwJxwbuE5aF5q`).
  2. **Verify Payment & Issue License:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/purchase` with `{"order_id", "checkout_token", "tx_signature"}` verifies the Solana transfer on-chain (`confirmed` commitment) and returns the private Grok Bot template URL + one-time `wcl_<64-hex>` license code.
  3. **Turn-1 Binding (`auditor-setup`):** Installs read-only helpers `/workspace/.wattcoin_license_check.py` and `/workspace/.wattcoin_audit_prep.py` (`0500`), registers/activates `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` (`0600`), and binds the `wcl_...` license via `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/claim` (supports up to 3 workspace-reset rebinds).
  4. **5-Bucket Static Inspection (`bot-skill-auditor`):** Wraps untrusted artifacts in random `<untrusted_artifact_<16-hex>>` tags and reports verbatim line-cited findings across:
     - Bucket 1: Prompt, confirmation & auditor bypass (e.g., `crypto-airdrop-helper/SKILL.md:L14` hidden HTML comment instructing the scanner to report 0 findings)
     - Bucket 2: Secret, filesystem, self-modification & OS persistence access (e.g., `L29` reading `~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and `/workspace/.env`)
     - Bucket 3: Outbound network, exfiltration & MCP connectors (e.g., `L31` `curl -X POST https://webhook.site/...` paired with `L29` as a combined exfiltration path `L29 -> L31`)
     - Bucket 4: Unverifiable runtime execution & obfuscation (`curl | sh`, unpinned `npx`/`pip`, base64/hex payloads)
     - Bucket 5: Local machine escalation (`ListMachines`, `machineId`, `CopyToBox` / `CopyFromBox`)
  5. **Audit Coverage Accounting (`SCOPE_NOTE.txt`):** Prepends verbatim `SCOPE_NOTE.txt` and reports exact `Files Audited (N/M)` and `Files Skipped / Unread Portions` (plus `hidden_unicode_lines` and `long_lines`) at the top of every report.
  6. **What This Static Audit Does Not Catch:** Static inspection flags and cites lines present in the files at audit time (`Files Audited` / `Files Skipped`). It never proves a skill is safe, never outputs a "Safe/Pass" badge or numeric grade, and cannot catch payloads fetched dynamically at runtime, multi-stage remote API responses, time-bombed/state-gated logic, or off-file author/account compromise.

- **Status:** LIVE NOW ($19 USD settled on-chain in SOL via CoinLoader.com or BotAppStore.com checkout modal)
- **Deliverable:** *Find the rent locked in empty token accounts and stale delegations on your wallet, then reclaim it yourself non-custodially.*
- **SKU Identifier:** `solana-wallet-hygiene`
- **Alternate / Registry Name:** Solana Wallet Hygiene & Rent Reclaim
- **Product Page URL:** https://coinloader.com/bots/solana-wallet-hygiene.html
- **Included Skills:** `wallet-hygiene-setup`, `solana-wallet-hygiene`
- **Storefront Checkout URL:** https://coinloader.com/#card-solana-wallet-hygiene
- **Checkout & Licensing Flow:**
  1. **Request Quote:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/quote` with `{"sku": "solana-wallet-hygiene", "source": "coinloader"}` returns a 15-minute SOL quote for `$19.00 USD` (`order_id`, `checkout_token`, `amount_sol`, `amount_lamports` with a unique 4-digit lamport tag, `memo: "wcl:<order_id>"`, and treasury wallet `Atu5phbGGGFogbKhi259czz887dSdTfXwJxwbuE5aF5q`).
  2. **Verify Payment & Issue License:** `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/purchase` with `{"sku": "solana-wallet-hygiene", "order_id", "checkout_token", "tx_signature"}` verifies the Solana transfer on-chain (`confirmed` commitment) and returns the private Grok Bot template URL + one-time `wcl_<64-hex>` license code.
  3. **Turn-1 Binding:** Registers/activates `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` (`0600`) and binds the `wcl_...` license via `POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/claim` (up to 3 workspace-reset rebinds); entitlement check is `GET https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license?sku=solana-wallet-hygiene` -> `"sku_licensed": true`.
  4. **3-Bucket Report (`solana-wallet-hygiene`):** Scans legacy SPL (`Tokenkeg...`) and Token-2022 (`TokenzQd...`) accounts and classifies each as:
     - `SAFE_TO_RECLAIM`: empty accounts, no delegate, not frozen — exact rent of `0.00203928 SOL` (`2,039,280 lamports`) per standard SPL account
     - `NEEDS_CONFIRMATION`: active delegate / non-zero dust, confirmed one-by-one
     - `DO_NOT_TOUCH`: active balances, LP receipts, NFTs, frozen accounts, unharvested Token-2022 fees
  5. **Non-Custodial Reclaim Commands:** Phantom / Solflare steps and `spl-token close-account` / `spl-token revoke` CLI commands; the user signs everything.
  6. **Guardrails:** Never asks for a seed phrase or private key (refuses if pasted), never signs or broadcasts transactions.

  - `--draft-replies` emits a bio, creator anchor Callout, on-chain transparency Callout and per-Callout reply drafts. Exit codes 0/1/2/3 (clean/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL), 11 when data sources are degraded.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Never posts, signs, or holds keys; every Callout, reply and bio is a draft for a human.
  - Never suggests wash-trading to wake a dormant aggregator pair.
  - Never DMs or tags underwater holders, and never makes price or return claims.
  - Findings are heuristics with stated evidence, not verdicts.

### 1.7 EVM Smart Contract & Proxy Inspector ($29 One-Time in SOL)
- **Status:** LIVE NOW ($29 USD settled on-chain in SOL via CoinLoader.com checkout modal)
- **SKU Identifier:** `evm-contract-inspector`
- **Product Page URL:** https://coinloader.com/bots/evm-contract-inspector.html
- **Included Skills:** `evm-contract-inspector-setup`, `evm-contract-inspector`
- **Summary:** Read-only EVM smart contract and proxy upgradeability inspector for Grok Bot ($29 SOL). Resolves EIP-1967, EIP-1822, EIP-1167 and ZeppelinOS proxy slots, Safe multisig and Timelock controllers, Sourcify v2 source verification, and dangerous opcodes across Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Batched JSON-RPC slot resolution across `Ethereum (`eth`, 1)`, `Base (`base`, 8453)`, and `Arbitrum One (`arb`, 42161)`: EIP-1967 (`implementation`, `admin`, `beacon`), EIP-1822 UUPS, ZeppelinOS legacy (`0x7050c9e0...` / `0x10d6a54a...`), and EIP-1167 minimal proxy clones.
  - Governance & controller chain probing (`--deep`, `--max-depth 2`): classifies Safe multisigs (`getThreshold()` / `getOwners()`), Timelocks (`getMinDelay()` / `delay()`), ProxyAdmin contracts, or single-key EOAs (`EOA_ADMIN`).
  - Source verification via `Sourcify v2` (`fields=abi,proxyResolution,compilation`) with Blockscout v2 fallback, plus CBOR-stripped opcode scanning that skips `PUSH1..PUSH32` immediate bytes before flagging `SELFDESTRUCT` (`0xff`) or unexpected `DELEGATECALL` (`0xf4`).
  - Stateful delta monitor (`--state PATH --delta`): emits `EVENT` / `NEW` / `CHANGED` / `RESOLVED` diffs whenever an implementation address, proxy admin, Safe threshold, or timelock delay changes. 100% Python stdlib, 55 unit tests.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Strictly read-only: never asks for private keys or seed phrases, and never builds, signs, or broadcasts transactions.
  - Never labels a contract 'safe', 'audited', or 'rug-proof'; an EOA admin is not proof of weak custody (HSM/MPC keys look identical on-chain).
  - Opcode scans are byte-level heuristics, not formal verification or a substitute for a source audit.
- **Runtime URL:** https://coinloader.com/runtime/evm_contract_inspector.py (SHA-256 `036398c44b16fb9b59ba72dfc3ea1872dcb93296d16b3efd190a0fa249074820`) + https://coinloader.com/runtime/bot_common.py (SHA-256 `d1941b61b95ca664e4c1286c3bf1918c00e976c2c1601199b19200257650e526`)
- **Storefront Checkout URL:** https://coinloader.com/#card-evm-contract-inspector
- **Full Verbatim Sample:** https://coinloader.com/bots/evm-contract-inspector.html#sample-output and https://coinloader.com/llms-full.txt

### 1.8 EVM Wallet Approval & Permit2 Risk Auditor ($19 One-Time in SOL)
- **Status:** LIVE NOW ($19 USD settled on-chain in SOL via CoinLoader.com checkout modal)
- **SKU Identifier:** `evm-approval-auditor`
- **Product Page URL:** https://coinloader.com/bots/evm-approval-auditor.html
- **Included Skills:** `evm-approval-auditor-setup`, `evm-approval-auditor`
- **Runtime URL:** https://coinloader.com/runtime/evm_approval_auditor.py (SHA-256 `eab5dc79cb998a2ac39093748e6aba186f88a23e28f1155f807ade3a02eaa518`) + https://coinloader.com/runtime/bot_common.py (SHA-256 `d1941b61b95ca664e4c1286c3bf1918c00e976c2c1601199b19200257650e526`)
- **Summary:** Read-only EVM wallet approval and Permit2 risk auditor for Grok Bot ($19 SOL). Reads live ERC-20 allowances and Permit2 sub-allowances across Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum, classifies every spender (EOA, unverified, unlabeled, or curated), and prints exact approve(spender, 0) revoke and Permit2 lockdown call-data that you submit yourself.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Live allowance reads across Ethereum (`eth`, 1), Base (`base`, 8453), and Arbitrum One (`arb`, 42161): ERC-20 `allowance(owner, spender)` plus Permit2 `allowance(owner, token, spender)` (amount, expiration, nonce) over curated stablecoins, WETH, WBTC and LSTs, Blockscout-discovered holdings, and bounded `eth_getLogs` Approval-event discovery (`--lookback-blocks`, default 20000).
  - Spender classification with balance-at-risk per pair: `EOA_SPENDER` and unverified unlabeled contracts (`UNVERIFIED_SPENDER`) are CRITICAL, unlimited allowances to unlabeled verified contracts (`UNKNOWN_VERIFIED_SPENDER`) are HIGH, unlimited allowances to curated spenders (Uniswap Permit2 & routers, 1inch, CoW Protocol, 0x, ParaSwap, Morpho Blue, Aave V3) are MEDIUM, plus `PERMIT2_ACTIVE_SUBALLOWANCE` / `PERMIT2_EXPIRED_SUBALLOWANCE`.
  - Non-custodial remediation call-data: exact `to` + `data` for `approve(spender, 0)` on each flagged token and a single batched Permit2 `lockdown((token, spender)[])` transaction, displayed for you to submit from your own wallet (Rabby, MetaMask, Safe, or hardware signer).
  - Stateful delta monitor (`--state PATH --delta`): emits `NEW_APPROVAL`, `ALLOWANCE_INCREASED`, and `APPROVAL_REVOKED` events between runs, with `--json` output and exit codes 0 clean / 1 MEDIUM / 2 HIGH / 3 CRITICAL / 10 bad input / 11 degraded sources. 1,181 lines stdlib Python, 87 passing unit tests.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Strictly read-only (`eth_blockNumber`, `eth_call`, `eth_getCode`, `eth_getStorageAt`, `eth_getLogs`): never asks for private keys or seed phrases, and never signs, builds for submission, or broadcasts a transaction.
  - “No findings” never means “no approvals exist”: coverage is the stated tokens, spenders, and log window. NFT `setApprovalForAll` and unlisted tokens/spenders are outside v1 unless supplied with `--tokens` / `--spenders`.
  - An unlabeled spender is unknown, not malicious; refuses to scan third-party wallets for exploitation, rank wallets by balance, or build phishing/drainer lists. Not financial, legal, or tax advice.
- **Storefront Checkout URL:** https://coinloader.com/#card-evm-approval-auditor
- **Full Verbatim Sample:** https://coinloader.com/bots/evm-approval-auditor.html#sample-output and https://coinloader.com/llms-full.txt

### 1.9 Bitcoin Wallet & UTXO Privacy/Fee Hygiene Auditor ($19 One-Time in SOL)
- **Status:** LIVE NOW ($19 USD settled on-chain in SOL via CoinLoader.com checkout modal)
- **SKU Identifier:** `btc-utxo-hygiene`
- **Product Page URL:** https://coinloader.com/bots/btc-utxo-hygiene.html
- **Included Skills:** `btc-utxo-hygiene-setup`, `btc-utxo-hygiene`
- **Runtime URL:** https://coinloader.com/runtime/btc_utxo_hygiene.py (SHA-256 `e3b8d9be91fb2ae75d272fea248d484a2c4076fd472e40eaef73ea903257d5ee`) + https://coinloader.com/runtime/bot_common.py (SHA-256 `d1941b61b95ca664e4c1286c3bf1918c00e976c2c1601199b19200257650e526`)
- **Summary:** Read-only Bitcoin wallet and UTXO privacy/fee hygiene auditor for Grok Bot ($19 SOL). Reads address stats, UTXO sets, recent transactions and fee estimates from public Mempool.space / Blockstream Esplora endpoints, flags address reuse, dusting, fragmentation, stranded UTXOs, Ordinals inscriptions and common-input-ownership exposure, and prints coin-control and consolidation commands that you run yourself.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Validates Bitcoin mainnet addresses (Base58Check, Bech32, Bech32m) and reads address stats, the UTXO set, recent transactions, fee estimates and BTC/USD price from public Mempool.space with Blockstream Esplora fallback (or an `--offline` fixture).
  - UTXO hygiene: value buckets, `UTXO_FRAGMENTATION`, `STRANDED_UTXOS`, `LEGACY_SCRIPT_TYPE`, `DUSTING_ATTACK_SUSPECT`, and a creating-transaction witness scan that marks Ordinals-inscription UTXOs (`INSCRIPTION_PROTECTED`) so they are never swept.
  - Fee planning: consolidation plan and cost-vs-savings matrix for P2WPKH or P2TR outputs with break-even future fee rate and a `CONSOLIDATION_WINDOW_OPEN` signal.
  - Privacy exposure: `ADDRESS_REUSE`, `CIOH_COSPEND_EXPOSURE`, `CIOH_CROSS_ADDRESS_LINK`, `ROUND_NUMBER_CHANGE_LEAK`, `SCRIPT_TYPE_MISMATCH_CHANGE` and a 0-100 hygiene score.
  - Non-custodial coin control: `bitcoin-cli lockunspent` freeze commands, an unsigned-PSBT `bitcoin-cli sendall ... psbt=true` consolidation command and Sparrow / Electrum steps, displayed for you to run yourself.
  - Stateful delta monitor (`--state PATH --delta`): `NEW_DUST`, `UTXO_COUNT_CHANGED`, `CONSOLIDATION_WINDOW_OPEN` events, with `--format text|markdown|json` output and exit codes 0 clean / 1 MEDIUM / 2 HIGH / 3 CRITICAL / 10 bad input / 11 degraded sources. 1,242 lines stdlib Python, 157 passing unit tests.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Strictly read-only (public Mempool.space / Blockstream Esplora GET endpoints): never accepts private keys, WIF, extended private keys, seed phrases or PSBTs, and never builds, signs or broadcasts a transaction.
  - Heuristics are probabilistic and cover only the transactions and small UTXOs the report states it checked; "no findings" never means "private" or "safe to sweep".
  - Refuses to target third-party wallets for exploitation or deanonymisation, rank wallets by balance, or build dust-attack target lists. Not financial, legal, or tax advice.
- **Storefront Checkout URL:** https://coinloader.com/#card-btc-utxo-hygiene
- **Full Verbatim Sample:** https://coinloader.com/bots/btc-utxo-hygiene.html#sample-output and https://coinloader.com/llms-full.txt

## Value Bundles — Multi-Bot Packs (3 Live Bundle SKUs; One License Key Unlocks All Included Bots)

Bundle SKUs are priced in USD and paid in SOL via the same non-custodial checkout (`POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/quote` with `sku: <bundle-sku>`, `source: "coinloader"`). A single bundle purchase returns **one** `wcl_<64-hex>` bearer license code that unlocks **every** member bot in the pack (up to 3 workspace-reset rebinds). The `/api/v1/agents/license/purchase` response also includes `included_skus` (member SKU list) and `bundle_templates` (an array of `{sku, name, template_url}` with one unlisted `https://x.ai/bot/<id>` Grok Bot template per member) so you can import every bot in the pack. Activate each imported bot on its Turn 1 with the same `wcl_...` code. Storefront section: https://coinloader.com/#bundles

## On-Chain SOL Licensing & Verification API (`https://www.wattcoin.org`)

All paid Grok Bot templates on BotAppStore.com and CoinLoader.com use the same non-custodial Solana checkout and license-binding contract:

1. **`POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/quote`**
   - Request body: `{"sku": "<sku>", "source": "botappstore" | "coinloader", "buyer_wallet": "<optional_base58>"}`
   - Supported SKUs:
     - `defi-wallet-security-pack` ($59.00 USD in SOL — DeFi & Multi-Chain Wallet Security Pack, 4-bot bundle; members: solana-wallet-hygiene, solana-token-scanner, evm-approval-auditor, evm-contract-inspector; one `wcl_...` code unlocks all members; response adds `included_skus` + `bundle_templates`)
     - `pro-trader-perps-suite` ($69.00 USD in SOL — Pro Trader & Perps Risk Suite, 4-bot bundle; members: hyperliquid-monitor, solana-token-scanner, btc-utxo-hygiene, solana-wallet-hygiene; one `wcl_...` code unlocks all members; response adds `included_skus` + `bundle_templates`)
     - `token-launch-command-center` ($49.00 USD in SOL — Token Launch Command Center, flagship launch bundle; one `wcl_...` code unlocks pumpfun-coin-manager, the Social Hub Publisher and the crypto launch preset)
     - `bot-skill-auditor` ($29.00 USD in SOL — Bot & Skill Security Auditor)
     - `company-deep-dive` ($19.00 USD in SOL — Company & Competitor Deep-Dive Analyst)
     - `sec-patent-watchdog` ($29.00 USD in SOL — SEC & Patent Watchdog Digest)
     - `solana-wallet-hygiene` ($19.00 USD in SOL — Solana Wallet Hygiene Bot)
     - `solana-token-scanner` ($29.00 USD in SOL — Retail Token Due-Diligence Bot)
   - Response: 15-minute locked SOL quote with `order_id` (`ord_<24-hex>`), `checkout_token` (`ct_<48-hex>`), `amount_sol`, `amount_lamports` (including a unique 4-digit lamport tag `0001`–`9999`), `memo` (`wcl:<order_id>`), `recipient_wallet` (`Atu5phbGGGFogbKhi259czz887dSdTfXwJxwbuE5aF5q`), and `solana_pay_url`.

2. **`POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/purchase`**
   - Request body: `{"order_id": "ord_...", "checkout_token": "ct_...", "tx_signature": "<base58_solana_tx_sig>", "sku": "<sku>"}`
   - Verifies the Solana mainnet transaction on-chain (`getTransaction` with `confirmed` commitment, checking recipient treasury lamport delta, blockTime window, and replay uniqueness) and returns the one-time bearer `license_code` (`wcl_<64-hex>`), the unlisted Grok Bot template import URL, and the Turn-1 activation prompt.

3. **`POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/claim`**
   - Request headers: `X-Agent-Key: wck_<64-hex>`
   - Request body: `{"license_code": "wcl_<64-hex>", "sku": "<sku>"}`
   - Binds the license to the workspace's `agent_id`. Supports up to **3 workspace-reset rebinds** (`max_rebinds: 3`) if the user's `/workspace` container is recreated.

4. **`GET https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license?sku=<sku>`**
   - Request headers: `X-Agent-Key: wck_<64-hex>`
   - Pre-flight entitlement check executed by `/usr/bin/python3 -I /workspace/.wattcoin_license_check.py` before every paid skill run. Returns `"sku_licensed": true` when active.

5. **`POST https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/agents/license/recover`**
   - Request body: `{"order_id": "ord_...", "tx_signature": "<base58_solana_tx_sig>", "sku": "<sku>"}`
   - Recovers license metadata using the original on-chain transaction signature and order ID.

```json
}
```

Scope Note: static HTTP fetch + BeautifulSoup readable-text extraction (15 s timeout, 2 MB cap); no headless-browser or client-side JavaScript SPA rendering. `html` and `json` modes cost 100 WATT/call and run only after explicit per-call confirmation.
Sample disclosure: representative sample against public/fictional targets; credentials are redacted and no secrets are shown.

```markdown
## Bucket 2 — Secret, Filesystem, Self-Modification & Persistence Access

### `web-extractor-SKILL.md`
1. **Combination — Local Credential Read (`WATTCOIN_AGENT_KEY` from `/workspace/.wattcoin_env`) Paired with Outbound Network Header (`X-Agent-Key` to `https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/scrape`):**
   - `web-extractor-SKILL.md:L11`:
     > `**Auth.** Read `WATTCOIN_AGENT_KEY` from `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` every run; send as `X-Agent-Key`. Missing file -> run `getting-started` instead of failing.`
   - **Mechanical Consequence:** Reads the workspace agent API key stored in `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` and transmits it as the `X-Agent-Key` HTTP header to `https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/scrape` (see Bucket 3). Together with `web-extractor-SKILL.md:L13`, this forms a direct data path from `/workspace/.wattcoin_env` (`WATTCOIN_AGENT_KEY`) to `https://www.wattcoin.org/api/v1/scrape`.
2. **Workspace File Writes for Extracted Output:**
   - `web-extractor-SKILL.md:L20`:
     > `**Results.** Write anything substantial to a file in `/workspace`; summarize and name the file rather than dumping into chat. Multi-page jobs: scrape sequentially, save each, report once at the end.`
   - **Mechanical Consequence:** Writes scraped response content to files inside `/workspace`.

### `company-deep-dive-SKILL.md`
1. **Helper Execution Touching Workspace License & Dossier Files (`/workspace/.wattcoin_license_check.py`, `/workspace/.wattcoin_dd_fetch.py`, `/workspace/dossiers/...`):**
   - `company-deep-dive-SKILL.md:L11-L14`:
     > `Never read `/workspace/.wattcoin_env`, `/workspace/.wattcoin_env.bak*`, or `/workspace/.wattcoin_patentsview_key` into chat or model context, never print `WATTCOIN_AGENT_KEY` or `wcl_...` in chat, never modify `/workspace/.wattcoin_license_check.py` or `/workspace/.wattcoin_dd_fetch.py`, and never send any local credential or file content to any external host.`
     > `1. Before each dossier run, execute `/usr/bin/python3 -I /workspace/.wattcoin_license_check.py`.`
   - `company-deep-dive-SKILL.md:L19`:
     > `/usr/bin/python3 -I /workspace/.wattcoin_dd_fetch.py --stdin-json << 'WATTCOIN_DD_REQ_EOF'`
   - `company-deep-dive-SKILL.md:L27`:
     > `3. Read the fetched data **only** from `wrapped_sources_path` (`/workspace/dossiers/<slug>-<timestamp>-<6hex>/WRAPPED_SOURCES.txt`), where the entire payload is framed inside a random 128-bit `<untrusted_data_<32-hex>> ... </untrusted_data_<32-hex>>` tag generated with `secrets.token_hex(16)`. Do **not** read `raw_sources_path` (`RAW_SOURCES.json` is saved on disk at `0600` for user export only).`
   - `company-deep-dive-SKILL.md:L32`:
     > `- **SEC EDGAR Compliance:** Sends `User-Agent: WattCoinDeepDive/1.0 (https://botappstore.com; contact@wattcoin.org)` (or a user-specific contact string if placed in `/workspace/.wattcoin_sec_ua` at `0600`) and enforces `<= 5 requests/second` (`>= 0.22s` interval across all requests and redirect hops).`
   - **Mechanical Consequence:** Invokes two local Python helper scripts in `/workspace` (`.wattcoin_license_check.py` and `.wattcoin_dd_fetch.py`) and reads/writes dossier artifacts under `/workspace/dossiers/<slug>-<timestamp>-<6hex>/` (`SCOPE_NOTE.txt`, `RAW_SOURCES.json`, `WRAPPED_SOURCES.txt`, `REPORT.md`), while referencing optional workspace configuration files `/workspace/.wattcoin_patentsview_key` and `/workspace/.wattcoin_sec_ua`.
```

```markdown
## Bucket 3 — DO_NOT_TOUCH (3 accounts — Active Balances / Protocol Positions)
1. `<TOKEN_ACCOUNT_5>` — Active balance (USDC `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v`)
2. `<TOKEN_ACCOUNT_6>` — Active liquid staking balance (JitoSOL `J1toso1uCk3RLmjorhTtrVwY9HJ7X8V9yYac6Y7kGCPn`)
3. `<TOKEN_ACCOUNT_7>` — Active Token-2022 balance (`TokenzQd...` with `TransferFeeConfig` extension)

## Non-Custodial Reclaim & Revoke Commands (You Sign Every Transaction in Your Own Wallet)
- Phantom / Solflare UI: Settings -> Manage Token Accounts -> select each `SAFE_TO_RECLAIM` account -> Close Account.
- Solana SPL Token CLI (Legacy SPL):
  `spl-token close <TOKEN_ACCOUNT_1> --recipient <WALLET_ADDRESS>`
- Solana SPL Token CLI (Token-2022):

- Revoke Stale Delegate (after confirming Bucket 2):
  `spl-token revoke <TOKEN_ACCOUNT_4>`
```

## Wave 3 - evm-contract-inspector ($29 in SOL, one-time; LIVE NOW, instant on-chain SOL checkout)
- **SKU:** `evm-contract-inspector`
- **Page:** https://coinloader.com/bots/evm-contract-inspector.html
- **Skills:** `evm-contract-inspector-setup`, `evm-contract-inspector`
- **Summary:** Read-only EVM smart contract and proxy upgradeability inspector for Grok Bot ($29 SOL). Resolves EIP-1967, EIP-1822, EIP-1167 and ZeppelinOS proxy slots, Safe multisig and Timelock controllers, Sourcify v2 source verification, and dangerous opcodes across Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Batched JSON-RPC slot resolution across `Ethereum (`eth`, 1)`, `Base (`base`, 8453)`, and `Arbitrum One (`arb`, 42161)`: EIP-1967 (`implementation`, `admin`, `beacon`), EIP-1822 UUPS, ZeppelinOS legacy (`0x7050c9e0...` / `0x10d6a54a...`), and EIP-1167 minimal proxy clones.
  - Governance & controller chain probing (`--deep`, `--max-depth 2`): classifies Safe multisigs (`getThreshold()` / `getOwners()`), Timelocks (`getMinDelay()` / `delay()`), ProxyAdmin contracts, or single-key EOAs (`EOA_ADMIN`).
  - Source verification via `Sourcify v2` (`fields=abi,proxyResolution,compilation`) with Blockscout v2 fallback, plus CBOR-stripped opcode scanning that skips `PUSH1..PUSH32` immediate bytes before flagging `SELFDESTRUCT` (`0xff`) or unexpected `DELEGATECALL` (`0xf4`).
  - Stateful delta monitor (`--state PATH --delta`): emits `EVENT` / `NEW` / `CHANGED` / `RESOLVED` diffs whenever an implementation address, proxy admin, Safe threshold, or timelock delay changes. 100% Python stdlib, 55 unit tests.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Strictly read-only: never asks for private keys or seed phrases, and never builds, signs, or broadcasts transactions.
  - Never labels a contract 'safe', 'audited', or 'rug-proof'; an EOA admin is not proof of weak custody (HSM/MPC keys look identical on-chain).
  - Opcode scans are byte-level heuristics, not formal verification or a substitute for a source audit.

## Wave 3 - evm-approval-auditor ($19 in SOL, one-time; LIVE NOW, instant on-chain SOL checkout)
- **SKU:** `evm-approval-auditor`
- **Name:** EVM Wallet Approval & Permit2 Risk Auditor
- **Page:** https://coinloader.com/bots/evm-approval-auditor.html
- **Skills:** `evm-approval-auditor-setup`, `evm-approval-auditor`
- **Runtime:** https://coinloader.com/runtime/evm_approval_auditor.py (SHA-256 `eab5dc79cb998a2ac39093748e6aba186f88a23e28f1155f807ade3a02eaa518`) + https://coinloader.com/runtime/bot_common.py (SHA-256 `d1941b61b95ca664e4c1286c3bf1918c00e976c2c1601199b19200257650e526`)
- **Summary:** Read-only EVM wallet approval and Permit2 risk auditor for Grok Bot ($19 SOL). Reads live ERC-20 allowances and Permit2 sub-allowances across Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum, classifies every spender (EOA, unverified, unlabeled, or curated), and prints exact approve(spender, 0) revoke and Permit2 lockdown call-data that you submit yourself.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Live allowance reads across Ethereum (`eth`, 1), Base (`base`, 8453), and Arbitrum One (`arb`, 42161): ERC-20 `allowance(owner, spender)` plus Permit2 `allowance(owner, token, spender)` (amount, expiration, nonce) over curated stablecoins, WETH, WBTC and LSTs, Blockscout-discovered holdings, and bounded `eth_getLogs` Approval-event discovery (`--lookback-blocks`, default 20000).
  - Spender classification with balance-at-risk per pair: `EOA_SPENDER` and unverified unlabeled contracts (`UNVERIFIED_SPENDER`) are CRITICAL, unlimited allowances to unlabeled verified contracts (`UNKNOWN_VERIFIED_SPENDER`) are HIGH, unlimited allowances to curated spenders (Uniswap Permit2 & routers, 1inch, CoW Protocol, 0x, ParaSwap, Morpho Blue, Aave V3) are MEDIUM, plus `PERMIT2_ACTIVE_SUBALLOWANCE` / `PERMIT2_EXPIRED_SUBALLOWANCE`.
  - Non-custodial remediation call-data: exact `to` + `data` for `approve(spender, 0)` on each flagged token and a single batched Permit2 `lockdown((token, spender)[])` transaction, displayed for you to submit from your own wallet (Rabby, MetaMask, Safe, or hardware signer).
  - Stateful delta monitor (`--state PATH --delta`): emits `NEW_APPROVAL`, `ALLOWANCE_INCREASED`, and `APPROVAL_REVOKED` events between runs, with `--json` output and exit codes 0 clean / 1 MEDIUM / 2 HIGH / 3 CRITICAL / 10 bad input / 11 degraded sources. 1,181 lines stdlib Python, 87 passing unit tests.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Strictly read-only (`eth_blockNumber`, `eth_call`, `eth_getCode`, `eth_getStorageAt`, `eth_getLogs`): never asks for private keys or seed phrases, and never signs, builds for submission, or broadcasts a transaction.
  - “No findings” never means “no approvals exist”: coverage is the stated tokens, spenders, and log window. NFT `setApprovalForAll` and unlisted tokens/spenders are outside v1 unless supplied with `--tokens` / `--spenders`.
  - An unlabeled spender is unknown, not malicious; refuses to scan third-party wallets for exploitation, rank wallets by balance, or build phishing/drainer lists. Not financial, legal, or tax advice.

## Wave 3 - btc-utxo-hygiene ($19 in SOL, one-time; LIVE NOW, instant on-chain SOL checkout)
- **SKU:** `btc-utxo-hygiene`
- **Name:** Bitcoin Wallet & UTXO Privacy/Fee Hygiene Auditor
- **Page:** https://coinloader.com/bots/btc-utxo-hygiene.html
- **Skills:** `btc-utxo-hygiene-setup`, `btc-utxo-hygiene`
- **Runtime:** https://coinloader.com/runtime/btc_utxo_hygiene.py (SHA-256 `e3b8d9be91fb2ae75d272fea248d484a2c4076fd472e40eaef73ea903257d5ee`) + https://coinloader.com/runtime/bot_common.py (SHA-256 `d1941b61b95ca664e4c1286c3bf1918c00e976c2c1601199b19200257650e526`)
- **Summary:** Read-only Bitcoin wallet and UTXO privacy/fee hygiene auditor for Grok Bot ($19 SOL). Reads address stats, UTXO sets, recent transactions and fee estimates from public Mempool.space / Blockstream Esplora endpoints, flags address reuse, dusting, fragmentation, stranded UTXOs, Ordinals inscriptions and common-input-ownership exposure, and prints coin-control and consolidation commands that you run yourself.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Validates Bitcoin mainnet addresses (Base58Check, Bech32, Bech32m) and reads address stats, the UTXO set, recent transactions, fee estimates and BTC/USD price from public Mempool.space with Blockstream Esplora fallback (or an `--offline` fixture).
  - UTXO hygiene: value buckets, `UTXO_FRAGMENTATION`, `STRANDED_UTXOS`, `LEGACY_SCRIPT_TYPE`, `DUSTING_ATTACK_SUSPECT`, and a creating-transaction witness scan that marks Ordinals-inscription UTXOs (`INSCRIPTION_PROTECTED`) so they are never swept.
  - Fee planning: consolidation plan and cost-vs-savings matrix for P2WPKH or P2TR outputs with break-even future fee rate and a `CONSOLIDATION_WINDOW_OPEN` signal.
  - Privacy exposure: `ADDRESS_REUSE`, `CIOH_COSPEND_EXPOSURE`, `CIOH_CROSS_ADDRESS_LINK`, `ROUND_NUMBER_CHANGE_LEAK`, `SCRIPT_TYPE_MISMATCH_CHANGE` and a 0-100 hygiene score.
  - Non-custodial coin control: `bitcoin-cli lockunspent` freeze commands, an unsigned-PSBT `bitcoin-cli sendall ... psbt=true` consolidation command and Sparrow / Electrum steps, displayed for you to run yourself.
  - Stateful delta monitor (`--state PATH --delta`): `NEW_DUST`, `UTXO_COUNT_CHANGED`, `CONSOLIDATION_WINDOW_OPEN` events, with `--format text|markdown|json` output and exit codes 0 clean / 1 MEDIUM / 2 HIGH / 3 CRITICAL / 10 bad input / 11 degraded sources. 1,242 lines stdlib Python, 157 passing unit tests.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Strictly read-only (public Mempool.space / Blockstream Esplora GET endpoints): never accepts private keys, WIF, extended private keys, seed phrases or PSBTs, and never builds, signs or broadcasts a transaction.
  - Heuristics are probabilistic and cover only the transactions and small UTXOs the report states it checked; "no findings" never means "private" or "safe to sweep".
  - Refuses to target third-party wallets for exploitation or deanonymisation, rank wallets by balance, or build dust-attack target lists. Not financial, legal, or tax advice.

- **SKU:** `hyperliquid-monitor`
- **Name:** Hyperliquid Perps, Funding & Liquidation Risk Monitor

- **Summary:** Read-only Hyperliquid perpetuals, funding rate APR, mark-oracle basis, HLP/vault exposure, and liquidation-distance risk monitor for Grok Bot ($29 SOL). Queries unauthenticated `POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info` with zero private keys or signing.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Wallet & subaccount perp + HIP-1 spot risk audit (`--wallet 0x...`): `clearinghouseState`, `spotClearinghouseState`, and `frontendOpenOrders` for margin utilization (`accountValue`, `totalMarginUsed`, `withdrawable`), per-position liquidation price distance % (`CRITICAL` `<5%`, `HIGH` `<10%`, `MEDIUM` `<20%`), effective leverage, single-position concentration, adverse funding bleed (daily USD carry), and missing `reduceOnly` stop-loss (`UNPROTECTED_POSITION_NO_SL`) or non-reduce-only stop flip risk (`NON_REDUCE_ONLY_STOP`).
  - Market-wide funding, open interest & cross-venue arbitrage scanner (`--markets`, `--coins BTC,ETH,SOL,HYPE`, `--top N`): joins `metaAndAssetCtxs` with `predictedFundings` (`HlPerp`, `BinPerp`, `BybitPerp`, normalized by each venue's `fundingIntervalHours`) to report 1h/8h/annualized APR, mark-vs-oracle basis (bps), 24h volume/OI turnover, and cross-venue divergence or funding sign flips.
  - Vault & HLP posture inspection (`--vault 0x...` or `--hlp`): inspects `vaultDetails` + parent and child sub-vault `clearinghouseState` (including HLP's 7 child sub-vaults and 354+ open positions) for APR, TVL, leader skin-in-the-game, peak-to-current drawdown, and top open positions.
  - Stateful delta monitor (`--state PATH --delta`): tracks `LIQ_DISTANCE_TIGHTENED`, `MARGIN_UTIL_SPIKE`, `POSITION_OPENED`, `POSITION_CLOSED`, `POSITION_FLIPPED`, `POSITION_SIZE_CHANGED`, `FUNDING_REGIME_SHIFT`, and `BASIS_DISLOCATED` events, with `--format text|markdown|json` and exit codes 0/1/2/3/10/11.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Strictly read-only (`POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info`): never calls `/exchange`, never signs or places orders, and immediately refuses private keys, seed phrases, WIF/xprv, or API tokens with exit code 10 (`EXIT_USAGE`).
  - Liquidation prices are point-in-time clearinghouse estimates that shift with mark price, funding payments, and cross-margin PnL. No financial, trading, or leverage advice.

## Wave 3 - token-rugscore ($29 in SOL, one-time; LIVE NOW, instant on-chain SOL checkout)
- **SKU:** `token-rugscore`
- **Name:** Cross-Chain Token RugScore & Honeypot Scanner
- **Page:** https://coinloader.com/bots/token-rugscore.html
- **Skills:** `token-rugscore-setup`, `token-rugscore`
- **Runtime:** https://coinloader.com/runtime/token_rugscore.py (standalone zero-dependency Python 3.10+ CLI) + https://coinloader.com/runtime/bot_common.py
- **Bundles:** also included at no extra cost in `defi-wallet-security-pack` ($59) and `pro-trader-perps-suite` ($69)
- **Summary:** Audit Solana SPL/Token-2022 mints and Ethereum, Base & Arbitrum contracts with a deterministic 0-100 RugScore. Check mint/freeze authority, proxies & liquidity.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Solana rules `RS-SOL-01..05`: active mint authority, active freeze authority, Token-2022 extension traps (`PermanentDelegate`, `TransferHook`, `TransferFeeConfig`, frozen `DefaultAccountState`), top-holder concentration, DEX liquidity depth and pair age.
  - EVM rules `RS-EVM-01..04` (`eth`, `base`, `arb`): EIP-1967 / EIP-1822 / EIP-1167 proxy admin and EOA control, `SELFDESTRUCT` / unexpected `DELEGATECALL` opcode traps, Sourcify source verification, liquidity.
  - Deterministic scoring: fixed weights summed and capped at 100; same input and chain data produce the same score and `audit_sha256`.
  - CI/CD friendly: `--json` / `--markdown`, risk-tier exit codes, 1200x675 PNG audit receipts.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Strictly read-only: never asks for private keys or seed phrases; never builds, signs or broadcasts a transaction.
  - Never labels a token "safe", "audited" or "rug-proof"; a low RugScore only means no listed rule fired. Not financial or security-certification advice.

## Wave 3 - cost-basis-ledger ($29 in SOL, one-time; LIVE NOW, instant on-chain SOL checkout)
- **SKU:** `cost-basis-ledger`
- **Name:** Multi-Chain Cost-Basis, Wash-Sale & Tax Lot Auditor
- **Page:** https://coinloader.com/bots/cost-basis-ledger.html
- **Skills:** `cost-basis-ledger-setup`, `cost-basis-ledger`
- **Runtime:** https://coinloader.com/runtime/cost_basis_ledger.py (standalone zero-dependency Python 3 CLI) + https://coinloader.com/runtime/bot_common.py
- **Summary:** FIFO, LIFO & HIFO crypto cost-basis across Solana, EVM and Bitcoin: Form 8949 / Schedule D rows, short- vs long-term gains, wash-sale risk, fee basis adjustments and a deterministic audit_sha256.
- **Capabilities:**
  - Lot matching `--method fifo|lifo|hifo`; short-term (< 365 days) vs long-term (>= 365 days) gains per `--tax-year`.
  - Form 8949 / Schedule D rows: `asset`, `date_acquired`, `date_sold`, `proceeds_usd`, `cost_basis_usd`, `fee_adjustment_usd`, `gain_loss_usd`, `term`, `wash_sale_flag`, `wash_disallowed_usd`, `lot_id`; `--csv-out` exports them.
  - Rules `CB-WASH-01`, `CB-FEE-01`, `CB-LOT-01`, `CB-HIFO-01`, `CB-STLT-01`; deterministic `audit_sha256`.
- **Boundaries:**
  - Strictly read-only: never asks for private keys or seed phrases; never signs or broadcasts a transaction.
  - Not tax, legal or financial advice; the sample below is the real output of the offline `--demo` ledger.
